items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua left practice early Thursday due to a calf injury and was listed as limited. Severity unknown; final report Friday ahead of vs Raiders.
items.why: Left early; listed limited on report. Rams already without Davante Adams (IR hamstring 6-10 weeks).
items.implication: Highly questionable for Week 7; monitor Friday. Target share concentration risk if sits.
items.opportunity: If OUT, elevated targets to remaining Rams WRs (Mumpfield etc.); prior Levitan note of 25-tgt potential without Adams/Ferguson.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall back to practice Thursday (limited), first since Week 3 quad injury. Chance to play vs MIA.
items.why: Returned to practice after multi-week absence.
items.implication: Game-time/monitor Friday report for Week 7 availability; ramp-up possible.
items.opportunity: If limited snaps, Braelon Allen elevated; full return restores RB1 role.

items.text: Multiple teams open to potential trade for Colts RB Jonathan Taylor; unclear if Colts ready to unload before deadline.
items.implication: ROS uncertainty; monitor for landing spot upgrade or Colts commit.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup value in IND if moved; Taylor remains elite if stays.

items.text: Saquon Barkley back/in line for Week 7 MNF vs DAL (RB15). Efficient in prior full games; Dallas top fantasy RB matchup. Limited practice Thursday.
items.why: Practiced limited; 'in line' to play; strong matchup history.
items.implication: RB1/2 with upside if full workload; monitor snaps post-hamstring.
items.opportunity: Carries/red-zone vs weak DAL run D; committee risk if limited.

items.text: Patriots CB Christian Gonzalez downgraded to questionable with illness then confirmed active for TNF vs Bears.
items.why: Illness downgrade then active on inactives.
items.implication: Full secondary for NE defense in TNF.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice officially DNP second straight day (hamstring).
items.implication: Likely OUT or highly limited Week 7; Xavier Worthy continues expanded role.
items.opportunity: Worthy/others elevated targets/routes while Rice sidelined.

items.text: Seahawks activated RB Zach Charbonnet from PUP list; significant step after full practice participation. Nearing return.
items.why: Activated after progressing to full participant.
items.implication: Imminent return; impacts SEA RB committee (Walker/others).
items.opportunity: Committee dilution or committee leader if healthy; handcuff value drops.

items.text: Josh Jacobs allowed facility access (meetings, lifting, medical, non-football). MarShawn Lloyd 49th EPA/rush, Kaleb Johnson 53rd of 54; OL mess too. Discussed Jacobs ROS on ETR Top-150 show.
items.why: Non-football activities permitted; backups poor efficiency data.
items.implication: Positive for near-term return/workload; long-term outlook covered on pod. Prefer Jacobs over committee once cleared.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/early-down opportunity expansion vs poor backup EPA; handcuff Lloyd/Johnson downgraded.
items.conflict: Berry hates Jacobs Week 7 due to workload question post-layoff.

items.text: Loves DeVonta Smith vs DAL (WR11). Elite volume; despite Thursday DNP (hamstring) still projected strong vs Cowboys.
items.implication: Start with confidence if active; volume floor high.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets even in limited Eagles offense.
items.conflict: Thursday DNP hamstring raises active risk for MNF.

items.text: Terrance Ferguson (IR eligible next week) recovery 'will take some time' per Schefter. Biggest Adams beneficiary delayed; Rams only answer now 25 Puka Nacua targets per game.
items.why: Ferguson delay + Adams IR; pure target vacuum.
items.implication: Puka massive volume spike ROS/Week 7 if healthy; elite WR1 lock.
items.conflict: New calf injury creates uncertainty overriding volume projection.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10). Bears good yardage spot; Brown back in real role with usage+matchup.
Hates Josh Jacobs @ DET (RB18). Workload question after long layoff; fade.
items.why: Layoff + uncertain snap share on return.
items.implication: Sit/flex down; prefer other RBs Week 7.
items.conflict: Levitan notes facility access + poor backup EPA supporting quicker full role.

items.text: Thorman Snaps & Pace: Up in pace TB@CAR; high volume GB@DET, LAR@LV. Slow slogs MIA@NYJ, SF@ATL, IND@MIN. Packers faster PROE/pass rate YoY; Lions/Rams/Raiders explosive/high snaps.
items.why: Neutral pace/PROE/snaps data; game environment analysis.
items.implication: Prefer skill players in high-pace/high-total spots (GB-DET, LAR-LV, TB-CAR); fade slog games.
items.opportunity: Elevated snap/route volume in up-tempo matchups for all skill positions.

items.text: Giants start JJ McCarthy vs HOU. YPT to Justin Jefferson: Mullens 10.8, Cousins 10.5, Darnold 10.0, Wentz 9.9, McCarthy 5.7. Small sample/scheme change but concern hard to ignore.
items.why: Historical YPT data with McCarthy far below prior QBs.
items.implication: Jefferson efficiency/volume risk under new QB; monitor Week 7.
items.opportunity: Lower YAC/deep threat if chemistry lag; still volume but ceiling capped.
